## Brand

Ship software peacefully

## Style foundations

- Visual style: modern, minimal, clean, editorial
- Typography scale: 12/14/16/20/24/32 | Fonts: primary=IBM Plex Serif,
  display=IBM Plex Serif, mono=JetBrains Mono | weights=100, 200, 300, 400, 500,
  600, 700, 800, 900
- Color palette: primary, secondary | Tokens: primary=#553F83,
  secondary=#111111, success=#16A34A, warning=#D97706, danger=#DC2626,
  surface=#553F83, text=#ffffff
- Spacing scale: 4/8/12/16/24/32

## Copy tone

- Tone: concise, confident, helpful.

## Design intent

Contemporary editorial style with serif typography, minimal palettes, and clean
layouts for polished digital products.
